# Murray Home Improvement

> Owner-operated, licensed and insured remodeling and building contractor based in Chelmsford, Massachusetts. Owner Eric Murray (Massachusetts Construction Supervisor License CSL #077319, Home Improvement Contractor registration HIC #174394) has more than 30 years of residential remodeling experience and is on every job himself. Free, itemized estimates: (978) 479-9406.

- Service area: Chelmsford, MA — including North, South, East and West Chelmsford and Chelmsford Center — and the five towns that border it: Lowell, Westford, Tyngsborough, Billerica and Carlisle.
- Work: kitchens, bathrooms, home additions and second-story additions, basement finishing, decks and porches, siding and exterior remodeling, roofing, windows and doors, and custom carpentry — frame to finish.
- Contact: (978) 479-9406 (call or text) · eric@murrayhomeimprovement.com · [free estimate request](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/free-estimate.html)

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/kitchen-remodeling.html): Custom kitchens built around how you actually cook and gather.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/bathroom-remodeling.html): Spa-grade baths with heated floors, custom tile, and double vanities.
- [Home Additions](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/home-additions.html): More space, built to match — additions that look original to the home.
- [Second-Story Additions](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/second-story-additions.html): Add a whole level without losing your yard.
- [Basement Finishing](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/basement-finishing.html): Turn unused square footage into real living space.
- [Decks & Porches](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/decks-porches.html): Outdoor living built to last New England seasons.
- [Siding & Exterior Remodeling](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/siding-exterior-remodeling.html): Fresh siding, trim, and curb appeal that transforms a home.
- [Roofing](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/roofing.html): Roofs that protect everything beneath them.
- [Windows & Doors](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/windows-doors.html): Tighter, brighter, quieter — and a better-looking home.
- [Custom Carpentry](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/custom-carpentry.html): Frame to finish — the craftsmanship behind every project.

## Projects

Real jobs photographed start to finish (the photos are from the work itself):

- [All projects](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/index.html)
- [Kitchen remodel, before and after](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/kitchen-remodel-before-and-after.html): A full kitchen remodel photographed start to finish: the old eat-in kitchen opened up around a big island, with a new bay window, wood-look tile floors, new cabinets and appliances, and a reworked laundry and half bath.
- [Custom kitchen with a big island](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/custom-kitchen-remodel.html): White shaker cabinets, a large island with a built-in microwave drawer, a green subway-tile backsplash, a gas range under a chimney hood and a full wall of pantry cabinets.
- [Dark-cabinet kitchen with granite countertops](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/dark-cabinet-granite-countertop-kitchen-remodel.html): Dark cabinetry, granite countertops, a large island and a GE Profile stainless gas range, opening onto the dining area.
- [Bathroom remodel with a heated tile floor](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/bath-remodel-with-heated-floor.html): A full bathroom remodel with electric radiant heat under the tile floor, a tiled tub surround with a niche, a grab bar and tile wainscoting.
- [Double-vanity bathroom remodel](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/double-bath-remodel.html): A bathroom remodel with a double vanity, marble-look tile, a tub and shower with a rain head and a hexagon-tile niche, and wood-look tile floors.
- [Second-story addition on a ranch](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/second-floor-addition.html): A single-story ranch getting a full second story, photographed before, through the tear-off and framing, to the new second floor sheathed in ZIP System panels.
- [Home addition, built from the ground up](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/addition-with-excavation-and-foundation.html): An addition built from the first dig: excavation, a poured concrete foundation, new siding, a covered side entry and a front portico.
- [Finished basement living space](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/finished-basement.html): A basement finished into real living space: a family room, a staircase with built-in shelving and a TV wall, and a bedroom/office.
- [Pressure-treated deck on a budget](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/budget-pressure-treated-deck.html): A budget-friendly pressure-treated deck: rotted framing behind the old deck was repaired first, then a new deck with stairs, railings and braced posts went on.
- [Therma-Tru entry doors](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/therma-tru-entrance-doors.html): Therma-Tru entry doors on several homes: stained and painted finishes, decorative glass, sidelights and a covered side entry.
- [Footbridge built for the Town of Chelmsford](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/projects/bridge-build-town-of-chelmsford.html): An arched wooden footbridge with railings, built for the Town of Chelmsford and set across a brook on a wooded trail.
